label: fbc binding
source_quote:
- name: resource
          value: $(params.release)
        - name: resultsDirPath
          value: $(tasks.collect-data.results.resultsDir)
        - name: ociStorage
          value: $(params.ociStorage)
        - name: resultArtifacts
          value:
            - "$(tasks.add-fbc-contribution-to-index-image.results.sourceDataArtifact)=$(params.dataDir)"
            - "$(tasks.extract-index-image.results.sourceDataArtifact)=$(params.dataDir)"

label: producer result interface
source_quote:
- name: sourceDataArtifact
      type: string
      description: Produced trusted data artifact

label: producer creation result path
source_quote:
params:
        - name: ociStorage
          value: $(params.ociStorage)
        - name: workDir
          value: $(params.dataDir)
        - name: sourceDataArtifact
          value: $(results.sourceDataArtifact.path)

label: status input interface
source_quote:
description: |-
    A tekton task that updates the passed CR status with the contents stored in the files in the resultsDir.

label: results directory interface
source_quote:
- name: resultsDirPath
      description: |
        Path to the directory containing the result files in the data workspace which will be added to the
        resource's status

label: array input interface
source_quote:
- name: resultArtifacts
      type: array
      description: Array of artifacts to use to obtain results
      default: []

label: array invocation binding
source_quote:
- name: use-trusted-artifact-array
      computeResources:
        limits:
          memory: 128Mi
        requests:
          memory: 128Mi
          cpu: 20m
      ref:
        resolver: "git"
        params:
          - name: url
            value: $(params.taskGitUrl)
          - name: revision
            value: $(params.taskGitRevision)
          - name: pathInRepo
            value: stepactions/use-trusted-artifact-array/use-trusted-artifact-array.yaml
      params:
        - name: sourceDataArtifacts
          value: $(params.resultArtifacts)
        - name: caCertPath
          value: $(params.caCertPath)

label: opaque status module
source_quote:
env:
        - name: "PARAM_DATA_DIR"
          value: "$(params.dataDir)"
        - name: "PARAM_RESULTS_DIR_PATH"
          value: "$(params.resultsDirPath)"
        - name: "PARAM_RESOURCE"
          value: "$(params.resource)"
        - name: "PARAM_RESOURCE_TYPE"
          value: "$(params.resourceType)"
        - name: "PARAM_STATUS_KEY"
          value: "$(params.statusKey)"
      command: ["python3", "-m", "release_service_utils.tasks.managed.update_cr_status"]

label: array extraction description
source_quote:
description: >-
    This stepaction extracts an array of Trusted Artifacts into a folder.

label: array extractor entrypoint args
source_quote:
params:
    - name: sourceDataArtifacts
      type: array
      description: Array of artifacts to extract
      default: []
    - name: caCertPath
      type: string
      default: "/mnt/trusted-ca/ca-bundle.crt"
      description: Path to CA certificate bundle for TLS verification with self-hosted certificates
  args:
    - use
    - "$(params.sourceDataArtifacts[*])"

label: shared image binding
source_quote:
- name: kaniko
      taskRef:
        name: kaniko
      params:
        - name: CONTEXT
          value: '$(params.pathToContext)'
        - name: IMAGE
          value: '$(params.imageUrl):$(params.imageTag)'
      workspaces:
        - name: source
          workspace: source
    - name: gke-deploy
      taskRef:
        name: gke-deploy
      runAfter:
        - kaniko
      params:
        - name: ARGS
          value:
            - 'run'
            - '--image=$(params.imageUrl):$(params.imageTag)'
            - '--filename=$(workspaces.source.path)/$(params.pathToKubernetesConfigs)'
            - '--cluster=$(params.clusterName)'
            - '--location=$(params.clusterLocation)'
            - '--project=$(params.clusterProject)'
            - '--output=/var/tmp/gke-deploy'

      workspaces:
        - name: source
          workspace: source

label: pipeline intended build/push/deploy
source_quote:
description: >-
    This Pipeline builds, pushes, and deploys your application to a Google Kubernetes
    Engine cluster using gke-deploy.
  workspaces:
    - name: source
      description: The workspace containing the source code which is to be build, pushed and deployed

label: kaniko destination interface
source_quote:
- name: build-and-push
    workingDir: $(workspaces.source.path)
    image: $(params.BUILDER_IMAGE)
    # specifying DOCKER_CONFIG is required to allow kaniko to detect docker credential
    # https://github.com/tektoncd/pipeline/pull/706
    env:
    - name: DOCKER_CONFIG
      value: /tekton/home/.docker
    args:
    - $(params.EXTRA_ARGS)
    - --dockerfile=$(params.DOCKERFILE)
    - --context=$(workspaces.source.path)/$(params.CONTEXT)  # The user does not need to care the workspace and the source.
    - --destination=$(params.IMAGE)
    - --oci-layout-path=$(workspaces.source.path)/$(params.CONTEXT)/image-digest

label: deployment interface
source_quote:
description: >-
    This Task deploys an application to a Google Kubernetes Engine
    cluster using gke-deploy

label: deployment invocation
source_quote:
steps:
  - name: gke-deploy
    image: gcr.io/cloud-builders/gke-deploy@sha256:6d18a1efabf8a7ea7f2169c93f3e01fc5b8247b12099618c496ab097aaae341f
    command: ["/gke-deploy"]
    workingDir: $(workspaces.source.path)
    args: ["$(params.ARGS)"]
